bio.intro: I'm Machaallah ADJIBOGOU, a Web and Mobile Developer specialized in Software Architecture based in Lomé.
bio.p1: My approach is built on technical rigor and deep system understanding. Before writing the first line of code, I analyze needs, define architecture and plan for scalability. For me, a successful application is one that lasts, performs and remains maintainable.
bio.p2: Specialized in modern Web technologies (Next.js, Node.js), mobile development (Flutter, Dart) and advanced WordPress (custom themes/plugins/elementor), I'm also passionate about Artificial Intelligence and its applications. I bring a cross-functional vision to projects: from database management to end-user experience, including cloud deployment and AI solution integration.

items.desc: Frontend architecture and development with Next.js (SSR/SSG/SEO), Headless WordPress integration (REST API) and performance optimization (Core Web Vitals). Maintenance and evolution of multiple platforms (TogoTech, SIN, ARCEP, etc.).
Development of a billboard management web application: Laravel backend (secure REST APIs), Vue.js frontend, role/permission management and analytical dashboards.
Flutter mobile application development, UI interface implementation, API integration and state management on products like Kweek and Afrostand.

process.label: Technical Process
process.title: Methodology
process.subtitle: A structured development cycle to ensure robust, scalable and performant solutions.

steps.title: Analysis & Strategy
steps.desc: Every project begins with a deep understanding of business objectives and technical constraints. Together, we define the functional scope and choose the most suitable tech stack to ensure the solution's longevity.

steps.title: Architecture & Modeling
steps.desc: Software architecture is the foundation of scalability. I design the database schema, API architecture and the overall application structure. This phase anticipates technical challenges before implementation.

steps.title: Development & Implementation
steps.desc: Code is written with rigor, following Clean Code and DRY principles. Whether for Web (Next.js) or Mobile (Flutter), the focus is on performance, readability and maintainability.

steps.title: Testing & Quality Assurance
steps.desc: Solution robustness requires rigorous validation. Unit tests, integration tests and code reviews ensure a bug-free experience and optimal security from day one.

steps.title: Deployment & Maintenance
steps.desc: Production deployment is secured via CI/CD pipelines. Once deployed, the project enters a monitoring and evolutionary maintenance phase to adapt to new needs and stay at the cutting edge.

process.philosophyQuote: "Technical rigor is not optional — it's the sine qua non for digital product success."
